title: Serialized remove-before-add index plan
description: Index remediation is not a bounded serial remove-before-add plan with fresh digest evidence.
rationale: Index budget remediation must remove deterministically before any addition and bind approval to current state.
remediation: Recompute a bounded digest-bound plan, remove extra indexes serially with readback, then add required indexes in contract order with typed payloads.

residualGate.description: Authorized index Apply and current tenant readback remain external.
